structured.answer: I'd open an account at Pesagot (פסגות) and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". The page says I end up with about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That number comes from the page's own amounts (10,000 ₪ now, 500 a month, 7% a year), not my 30,000, so mine would be different. If Pesagot feels too unfamiliar, Leumi comes second at 83,396 ₪.

stuck.where: Top calculator, סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית
stuck.why: It was already filled in with 10,000 and 500, not my numbers. I left it as it was, so the 86,492 isn't really about my money.

stuck.where: Box 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים'
stuck.why: The first big number I saw was 6,876 ₪. For a second I thought that was what I'd end up with, then I realised it's the cost.
Pesagot is top, but Leumi is the bank I actually know. The gap is about 3,000 ₪, so I hesitated.

stuck.where: Fund list, the hedged fund 'הראל מחקה (4A) ... מנוטרלת מט"ח'
stuck.why: 'בין +2,212 ל־-23,766 ₪': a range with a big minus put me right off that one.

findings.what: The first big shekel figure is the cost (6,876), not what you end up with. Easy to read it the wrong way round.
The final amount (86,492) only shows up at the bottom of screen 3, inside a list. It should be up top in big letters.
The defaults (10,000 / 500) aren't my amounts, so the answer isn't about me unless I play with sliders.
Too many look-alike accounts (15) and funds (19). Without the ★ הזול tag and 'הבחירה' I'd have closed the page.
The hedging section is long and full of percentages and minus signs. I lost interest there and would have stopped.
Lots of terms with no explanation: דמי משמרת, נאמן, 4D/4A, נטרול מט"ח.
The minus amounts next to funds (-447 ₪) look scary. It isn't clear they're just 'less than the chosen fund'.
